reasoning_content: The timestamps in the container are fluctuating wildly (a mix of 10:xx and 12:xx). Let's just use HTTP to verify the web app and API endpoints instead.

action.command:
echo "=== XPlanManagerWeb ==="; timeout 40 curl -s -o /tmp/mgr.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-manager-web/"
grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*</title>|xplanmanager" /tmp/mgr.html | head -3
echo "=== XPlanValidatorWeb ==="; timeout 40 curl -s -o /tmp/val.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-validator-web/"
grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*</title>|xplanvalidator" /tmp/val.html | head -3
echo "=== ROOT (xplan-webpages) ==="; timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/" -o /tmp/root.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n"; grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/root.html | head -2
